title: Settings

data.title: Data Management
data.description: Manage backup/restore, trash, and team workspace tools under Settings.
data.backupDescription: Create snapshots, review backup history, and restore data.
data.trashDescription: Restore deleted components or permanently remove them.
data.teamDescription: Manage team members, permissions, and shared skills.

enabledAgents.title: Enabled AI agents

workspaceDescription: Register project root paths to include components in the scan scope.

onboardingDescription: You can replay the guide tour if you are new.

display.title: Display
display.description: Configure theme, font size, and layout.
display.stylePresetDescription: Classic keeps the current look. Neon and Editorial change the tone, texture, and visual mood.

notification.title: Notification
notification.description: Enable Toast notifications and configure by type.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Configure auto scan and experimental features.

monitoring.title: Privacy and diagnostics
monitoring.crashReportingDesc: Automatically sends diagnostic information when the app hits an error.
monitoring.performanceMonitoringDesc: Collects diagnostic data needed to understand slowdowns, hangs, and responsiveness issues.
monitoring.usageAnalyticsDesc: Collects anonymous statistics about the screens and features people use most.
monitoring.privacyNote: You can turn all of these off at any time. If you need to share detailed logs, use Debug Mode in Installed App Diagnostics below.
monitoring.desktopStatusDescription: Shows the current PostHog initialization, identity, and ingestion state for the Desktop build in read-only form.
monitoring.desktopStatusUnavailable: The Desktop analytics bridge is not available yet.

degradedReasons.analyticsIdentityLoadFailed: Failed to load the installation identity.
degradedReasons.analyticsIdentityPending: The installation identity is still loading.
degradedReasons.posthogNotReady: The PostHog SDK is still initializing.

desktopDebug.title: Installed App Diagnostics
desktopDebug.description: Enable Debug Mode, reproduce the issue, and export a diagnostic bundle for the GitHub issue.
desktopDebug.debugModeHelp: Detailed logs are collected while enabled. It automatically expires after 24 hours.
desktopDebug.debugModeLoadError: Failed to load Debug Mode settings.
desktopDebug.debugModeUpdateError: Failed to update Debug Mode settings.
desktopDebug.analyticsSelfTestDescription: In Debug Mode, send a verification event or exception to validate the current PostHog project ingestion path.

tagManagement.editTagDescription: You can modify the tag color and description.
tagManagement.deleteTagConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the {{name}} tag?

dangerZone.title: Danger Zone
dangerZone.description: Factory reset deletes all components, usage stats, and dependency data, then rescans from scratch.
dangerZone.factoryResetConfirmMessage:
The following data will be permanently deleted:
- All component data (recoverable via rescan)
- All usage statistics (deleted session logs are NOT recoverable)
- All dependency data (recoverable via re-analysis)

Preserved: Presets/Collections, Settings
dangerZone.factoryResetSuccess: Factory reset complete — {{projects}} projects, {{components}} components recovered
